name: Jai Balaji Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1999, Jai Balaji Industries Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of Iron and Steel products [1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
JBIL is a fully integrated steel manufacturer and one of Eastern India’s largest private producers of value-added products, including Ductile Iron (DI) Pipes and Specialized Ferro Alloys.
It is recognized as a 3-Star Export House, exporting to over 40 countries.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 48.2% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoters have pledged or encumbered 26.0% of their holding.
